none: PAS LON-D190C6: Roman ceramic stamped amphora handle dating AD 2nd century
contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A Roman ceramic stamped amphora handle dating AD 2nd century. This handle is from a Dressel 20 amphora which would have been large and globular with cylindrical handles and a prominent beaded or angular rim. The fabric is granular. The handle is stamped with an inscription which reads "C . V . [-]". Fiona Seeley identified this as a Dressel 20 and notes that it would have contained olive oil and was produced in the Baetica region of Spain. Calender (1965 no.506) suggests C . V . [-] may be for C. Valeri Variani. Glynn Davis also found a very similar parallel within the London Archaeological Archive and Research Centre Acc. No. 11295. which is published in Funari (1996:72 no. 247).…
